description: Make an API key and have Pidgeon put it straight on a Vercel project as a sensitive variable, through the account’s Vercel installation, so the key never passes through this chat. The answer never holds the key, only where it went (delivered_to). The project must be one the account’s Vercel installation was given; a variable of that name that Pidgeon did not set is never replaced. Access is read, draft, send or admin, and never more than your own. Needs the Everything level, of the whole account.

access.description: What it may do; read when left out.

name.description: Where the key will live, e.g. "support agent".

targets.description: Its environments; production and preview when left out.

test.description: A test key: its mail never leaves Pidgeon.
